verdict.rationale: Insomnia's pre-request and after-response scripts run custom logic automatically around request events, such as changing environment variables, auth or request contents. Inso CLI can also run tests automatically inside CI/Git workflows, with exit codes that pass or fail builds. This is event-hooked scripting scoped to individual requests and CI pipelines, not a general rules engine. Missing for 10: a declarative rule/trigger system, event sources beyond request send/response and CI runs (e.g. schedules, webhooks, app events), configurable actions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
